name: filetree
description: An IDE-style file tree for Claude Code that shows what Claude is doing and where in files

activity.title: Claude activity
activity.description: Which of Claude's file activity shimmers in the tree: files read with the Read tool or Bash readers (rg, grep, find, cat) in blue, writes in yellow and git actions in their own hues; also which files outside the tree's folder are listed above it

glyphs.title: Glyphs
glyphs.description: Icon set: auto uses Nerd Font icons when one is installed here, except in the desktop app; plain uses Unicode only

follow.title: Follow Claude
follow.description: on: the tree scrolls to what Claude reads, writes or commits. off: the view stays where you put it and only your own scrolling moves it; highlights still show.

root.title: Tree folder
root.description: pinned: the tree stays on the folder it opened on, or the one you move it to. follows cwd: it moves whenever Claude's shell changes folder (a cd, a worktree). The badge beside the path switches between the two.

open.title: Open with
open.description: What a double-click or Enter does with a file. preview (default): show it in the pane (left goes back, ↗ opens the default app). app (or empty): the default app. Anything else is a command run instead: {path} is the file and {dir} its folder; without {path} the path goes last. Words split on spaces, quotes keep a word whole, and no shell runs it. It should start the viewer and return; on Linux it runs detached.

startOpen.title: Open on start
startOpen.description: Whether the tree opens by itself when a session starts. desktop (default): in the desktop app only; in the CLI, /filetree opens it. always: in both. never: only /filetree opens it.
